user.title: Fridge Vision Inventory
user.description: Connect the vision integration to the Fridge Vision AI add-on and simple_inventory.

data_description.inventory_entity: The sensor.* entity created by simple_inventory (e.g. sensor.fridge).
data_description.ai_service_url: Base URL of the add-on API, e.g. {example_url}.
data_description.camera_entity: Camera used to grab frames while the door is open.
data_description.door_sensor_entity: Binary sensor reporting door state (on = open).
data_description.capture_fps: Frames per second captured during door-open (1-10).
data_description.motion_vector_insert_direction: Direction the hand moves when inserting items into the fridge.
data_description.confidence_threshold: Minimum detection confidence required to change inventory quantities.
data_description.notify_device: Notify target for ambiguous movements, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Vision AI service. Make sure the Fridge Vision AI add-on is running.

abort.already_configured: Fridge Vision Inventory is already configured.

reparameterize_model.name: Reparameterize model
reparameterize_model.description: Gathers all prompts starting with 'ai:' from simple_inventory and sends them to YOLO-World via /api/set_classes.
